li.p: Stop the vehicle and open the passenger’s door with the EV button in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position and the vehicle shifted to P (Park).
Adjust the passenger’s seat and seatback to the foremost position.
Press the passenger’s seat movement switch (reclining, cushion height) forward over 2 seconds simultaneously.

section.title: While resetting relaxation comfort seat

li.p: Resetting starts with a notification sound.
The passenger’s seat and seatback is re-adjusted to the default position (central position) with the notification sound.

section.p: However, in the following cases, the resetting procedure and the notification sound may stop.

li.p: The seat control switch is operated.
The gear is shifted out of P (Park).
The driving speed exceeds 5 km/h (3 mph).
While integrated memory system is being reset, if the resetting and notification sound stops incompletely, restart the resetting procedure again.
Make sure that there are no objects around the driver’s seat in advance of resetting the integrated memory system.
After resetting the integrated memory system, the adjustment for the driver seat must be stored again to recall the memory position.
